items.title: Audit lifecycle node coverage for all story phases (INIT through DONE)
items.context: Open 3+ stories from different phases in the lineage graph. Verify: INIT shows ROOT+INPUT; PLAN shows +PLAN nodes; DEV shows +DISPATCH+RESULT; REVIEW shows +REVIEW+FINDING; DONE shows full chain including GATE+AUTHORITY+DONE. Document any missing nodes in lattice-console-serve.js buildLineageGraph.
items.userSees: Clicking any story phase in the story list opens a lifecycle graph that includes all nodes appropriate for that phase — no blank or empty graphs for in-progress stories.

happy.desc: Open a PLAN-phase story in the lineage graph — see ROOT, INPUT, and at least one PLAN node rendered
Open a REVIEW-phase story — see DISPATCH, RESULT, REVIEW, and FINDING nodes where events exist in process-events.jsonl
Open a DONE story — verify all 7 layer types are present: root, input, plan, agent, review, gate, authority

edge.desc: INIT-phase story with only 1-2 events shows ROOT + INPUT without crashing

adversarial.desc: Story with zero process-events.jsonl shows empty-state message, not a JS error in the browser console

verificationEvidence.note: B-32b9 graph shows: root, input-req, 4 init-review agent nodes in plan layer, 4 pending CHK nodes in agent layer, evidence-gate, done — 12 nodes total. Preview screenshot at 27% scale confirms all nodes visible.

B-0414 graph shows: root, input-req, 2 init-review plan nodes, 3 pending CHK nodes, gate, done — 9 nodes. No process-events.jsonl dispatch events exist on main for this story yet so no DISPATCH/RESULT/REVIEW/FINDING nodes; graph shows phase-appropriate available nodes without crash.

verificationEvidence.command: Open demo story in Lineage Graph (mirrors a DONE story with all layers)
verificationEvidence.note: Demo data loaded via LatticeLineage.demo() shows: root, input, plan-review-r1/r2, dispatch CHK-001/CHK-002, result, loop-reflection, rev-beh/rev-doc/rev-qual review nodes, finding nodes, gate, done — all 7 layer types present (root/input/plan/agent/review/gate/authority). No JS errors in console.

items.title: Surface LLM interaction data for Claude Code dispatch stories (non-Codex)
items.context: Stories dispatched via claude-code runtime have no codex_cli events. They do have verificationIntent + verificationEvidence in checklist.json and dispatch/subagent_result timestamps. Ensure dispatch nodes for these stories show: (a) LLM verification intent cases, (b) duration+attempts from timestamps, (c) result nodes show LLM verification evidence with pass/fail. lattice-console-serve.js buildLineageGraph handles this; lattice-lineage.js renderDetail must render codexCallsHtml gracefully when codexCalls is empty.
items.userSees: Clicking a dispatch node on any active story shows its verificationIntent cases (happy/edge/adversarial) and, after result, the verificationEvidence commands with pass/fail verdicts — even with no codex_cli events.

happy.desc: Click a dispatch node on a Claude Code story — panel shows verification intent with intent cases and no LLM calls section when codex events are absent
Click the corresponding result node — panel shows verification evidence with evidence commands and pass count

edge.desc: Story with empty verificationIntent array shows no LLM intent section and no JS error

adversarial.desc: codexCalls empty array does not render an empty LLM calls section header

items.title: Show reviewer LLM interaction content in review and finding nodes
items.context: Review-phase nodes (review_pass, reviewer_finding) represent reviewer agent LLM interactions. Each review_pass has a reviewPassId linkable to review-passes.json (note field = reviewer reasoning). Each reviewer_finding has a findingId linkable to findings.json (desc field). lattice-console-serve.js already reads these files; ensure the review and finding nodes expose the note/desc content so renderDetail can display it as the reviewer LLM output.
items.userSees: Clicking a REVIEW node shows the reviewer agent note (what the reviewer LLM output said). Clicking a FINDING node shows the finding description. Both visible in the right detail panel.

happy.desc: Click a review node on a REVIEW-phase story — right panel shows "Review Note" section with the reviewer agent note text from review-passes.json
Click a finding node — panel shows "Finding" section with severity label and description text from findings.json

edge.desc: Review node whose reviewPassId has no matching entry in review-passes.json shows the review node without a Review Note section and without crashing

adversarial.desc: A reviewer_finding event whose findingId has no matching entry in findings.json renders the finding node with an empty Finding section rather than undefined or a JS TypeError

items.title: Verify auto-fit works across all navigation paths to the lineage graph
items.context: The _fitPending + onVisible() mechanism was added to handle the case where LatticeLineage.open() is called while the lineage panel is hidden (display:none), making container dimensions zero. Must verify all three navigation paths: (a) clicking story list item, (b) clicking trace button from Active Stories, (c) clicking Lineage Graph nav link with a previously loaded story.
items.userSees: Whenever the lineage graph loads or the user navigates to the Lineage Graph page, the graph auto-fits to show all nodes at correct scale — no manual Fit button click needed.

happy.desc: From Overview page, click trace button on any story row — lineage page opens and graph auto-fits showing all nodes at 20-40% scale
Navigate away and back via Lineage Graph nav item — previously loaded graph re-fits correctly

edge.desc: Story with only 2 nodes (INIT phase) auto-fits to a reasonable scale and not stuck at 10%

adversarial.desc: Rapidly switching between two stories does not leave graph stuck at 100% scale
